title: Charged twice this month
description: I see two identical charges of $49 on my credit card for the March invoice. Please refund the duplicate.

title: How do I download past invoices?
description: Our accountant needs PDFs of all invoices from last year. Where can I find them?

title: Upgrade to annual plan
description: We'd like to switch from monthly to annual billing. Will we get the discount applied to the remaining days?

title: Card declined but subscription cancelled
description: My card was declined on renewal and now my whole team lost access to the workspace. We need it back today, I've updated the card.

title: Wrong amount on invoice
description: Invoice #4821 bills us for 12 seats but we only have 10 active users. Can you correct it before we pay next week?

title: Whole app is down
description: Nobody in our company can load the dashboard, we get a 502 Bad Gateway error on every page since 9am.

title: Export to CSV produces empty file
description: When I export the reports page to CSV the file downloads but has only the header row. Copy-paste from the table still works.

title: Button text slightly cut off
description: On the settings page the 'Save changes' button text is cut off on small screens. Purely cosmetic.

title: Data disappeared after sync
description: After last night's sync all of our customer records from the past two weeks are gone. This is critical, we have no other copy.

title: API webhook retries too slow
description: Webhooks that fail are retried after an hour. Our integration still works but events arrive late. Is this configurable?

title: Mobile app crashes on launch
description: Since updating to version 5.2 the iOS app crashes immediately on launch for me. The web version works fine as a workaround.

title: Page loads slowly
description: The projects page takes around 6-8 seconds to load in the mornings. It's annoying but usable.

title: Locked out of my account
description: I entered the wrong password too many times and now my account is locked. I can't do any work until it's unlocked.

title: Change my email address
description: I'd like to change the email on my profile from my personal address to my work one.

title: Someone else logged into my account
description: I got an alert about a login from another country that wasn't me, and my profile name was changed. I think my account was hacked.

title: 2FA codes not accepted
description: My authenticator app codes are rejected every time. I can still get in with a backup code but only have two left.

title: Delete my account
description: Please delete my account and all associated personal data. I no longer use the service.

title: Can't invite new team member
description: When I try to give a colleague admin permissions the role dropdown is greyed out. She can still view projects in the meantime.

title: Please add dark mode
description: It would be great to have a dark theme for the app, especially for working late.

title: Integration with Google Calendar
description: Could you add a way to sync task due dates to Google Calendar? We'd use it every day.

title: Bulk edit for tasks
description: Suggestion: let us select multiple tasks and change their assignee at once instead of one by one.

title: Request for SSO support
description: Our security team requires SAML single sign-on before we can roll the product out to 500 employees. Is it on the roadmap?

title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Would love keyboard shortcuts for creating a new item and searching. Small thing but would save time.

title: Do you have a partner program?
description: We're an agency and would like to know if you offer a partner or reseller program.

title: Great product!
description: Just wanted to say the new release is excellent, our team loves the new timeline view.

title: Where is your office located?
description: We need your company's registered address for our vendor onboarding form.

title: Question about data retention
description: How long do you keep our data after we cancel? Our compliance team needs to know before we sign the renewal next month.

title: Payment page shows an error
description: When I try to update my credit card the payment page throws 'Something went wrong'. My subscription renews in 3 days.
